name: 993 front lid, composite skin with inner frame (PicoGK)
material_candidate: organic matrix composite (glass, carbon or hybrid), layup to be determined
picogk_enhancement: Replaces the cylindrical cap with a doubly curved skin in the 993 plan shape (headlamp waist, curved nose, rounded corners) falling toward the nose, a rolled edge with a return flange all round, and a bonded inner frame: a perimeter hat section opened by a field of lightening holes (also the drain and inspection path) plus an X brace and a centre rib under the skin.

width_mm.note: F0 lid width hypothesis (scripts/build_993_concept_f0.py), widest at the windscreen edge

length_mm.note: F0 lid length hypothesis, nose to windscreen edge in plan

vehicle_width_bound_mm.note: SRC-ASTRA-993-TYPE-APPROVAL-DIMENSIONS vehicle width; an upper bound only, not used by the geometry

skin_mm.note: F0 composite skin hypothesis (original steel estimated at 0.6 mm)

nose_drop_mm.note: longitudinal fall of the surface from the windscreen edge to the nose; not measured

nose_width_ratio.note: plan width at the nose relative to the rear width (headlamp waist)

waist_start_ratio.note: start of the headlamp waist transition, fraction of the length from the nose

waist_end_ratio.note: end of the headlamp waist transition

nose_curve_mm.note: sweep-back of the nose edge at its corners

front_corner_radius_mm.note: plan radius of the nose corners

rear_corner_radius_mm.note: plan radius of the windscreen-side corners

edge_roll_radius_mm.note: outer radius of the rolled edge between skin and return flange

flange_depth_mm.note: return flange depth below the skin

frame_inset_mm.note: inner frame outer edge, inboard of the lid edge

frame_depth_mm.note: hat-section depth below the skin surface

frame_laminate_mm.note: inner frame panel and wall thickness

lightening_hole_diameter_mm.note: holes in the frame panel (lightening, drainage, inspection)

rib_thickness_mm.note: X brace and centre rib thickness

rib_depth_mm.note: X brace and centre rib depth below the skin surface

open_interfaces: hinge interfaces (positions, fasteners) - not measured, not drawn
latch and safety catch interface - not measured, not drawn
gap and flush to fenders, bumper and cowl - not measured
true surface: to be taken from a sound, undeformed original panel (scan)
status: F0 concept geometry - not fitted, not tested, not safe, not released, not a print file
